notes.title: WORIDII Prolog: Robenea
notes.content:
Shorten your wait for the game!
Big news — the WORIDII universe is growing! In the following months we will publish seven short stories taking place in the WORIDII and introducing our main protagonist, Rob.

Look forward to:
[olist]
 Three Bite Marks (March)
 The Ancient Way (April)
 The Incident (May)
 For the Sake of Humanity (June)
 The Mechanic (July)
 Two Branches of the Same Tree (August)
 The Letter (September)
[/olist]
Read soon on WORIDII Prolog: Robenea!
